name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          node-version: '20'

      - run: npx tsc --noEmit

  test:
    name: Run Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

  build:
    name: Build Project
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build

  codeql:
    name: CodeQL Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: javascript,typescript
      - uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

  test:

      - run: npm ci

  build:
